name: ICICI Bank Ltd.
business_summary: India's second-largest private bank (retail, SME, corporate, treasury) with a ~Rs14 lakh cr loan book (derived), granular retail deposits and subsidiaries in life insurance, general insurance and asset management. Q2 FY27 PAT Rs14,843cr (+20% YoY), NII +18%, NIM down ~12bp YoY on FCNR(B) deposits and lower rates earlier in the year, provisions lower. Stock at 1480, near 52-week high, +10.7% over 12 months. Valued at a premium to peers on ROE ~17% and clean asset quality.

exposures.mechanism: +3pp system loan growth -> ICICI NII/fee +~3% (loan-led, NIM flat) -> PAT +3.5%; persistence 0.5, EV/MCap ~1 (bank, P/B based) => +1.7, rounded to +2.0. RBI expects credit growth to moderate from 18-19% as the hike transmits, so the risk is skewed to the downside.

evidence.note: RBI: credit growth to moderate from 18-19% as rate hike transmits
Q2 FY27 PAT Rs14,843cr +20%, NII +18%, NIM down 12bp YoY, provisions lower (Fortune India/Business Standard/Upstox headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +3pp deposit growth/funding ease -> cost of funds -5bp on ~4.5% CoF -> NIM +3-4bp (~+1% NII) and more room to lend; PAT +1.5-2%, persistence 0.5 => +0.8-1.2. System deposit growth was 15.4% in Aug 2026 (highest since Dec 2016) so funding is not scarce; the marginal value is lower than for deposit-short banks.

evidence.note: Bank deposit growth 15.4%, highest since Dec 2016 (Business Standard)

exposures.mechanism: +25bp: ~50-55% of loans are repo/EBLR-linked and reprice within a quarter, deposits reprice with a lag -> NIM +6-8bp for 2-3 quarters => NII +1.5%, PAT +2% x persistence 0.25 = +0.5. Offsets: valuation/discount-rate (P/B ~3x for a bank growing 14-16%) -0.7 and slower credit demand -0.3 => net ~-0.5. Sign is genuinely uncertain: RBI hiked to 5.50% on 2026-10-07 (first in ~4 yrs); NIM benefit shows from Q3/Q4 FY27. Do not stack with the G-sec edge for the valuation part.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo to 5.50%, stance calibrated tightening (Hindu/Reuters/Moneycontrol headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +25bp G-sec: AFS/HFT book ~20% of ~Rs3.5 lakh cr investments (model knowledge, unverified) x modified duration ~2 -> MTM ~Rs250-300cr pre-tax = ~0.4% of annual PAT (~Rs58k cr); the main channel is the discount rate on a ~3x P/B stock: +25bp on cost of equity ~ -1% to value => -1.2 total. Moderated because ICICI's trading book is small.

evidence.note: investment book composition not fetched; verify in Q2 FY27 investor presentation

exposures.mechanism: +50bp credit cost: loans ~Rs14 lakh cr (approx, derived) x 0.5% = Rs7k cr vs annual PBT ~Rs78k cr => PAT -9%; persistence 0.5 => -4.2. Q2 FY27 provisions fell and asset quality improved so starting point is benign (credit cost well below the through-cycle level) - convex downside.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 PAT Rs14,843cr +20%, NII +18%, NIM down 12bp YoY, provisions lower (Fortune India/Business Standard/Upstox headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +1pp delinquencies on the unsecured book (cards+PL+business banking small-ticket ~9-10% of loans, model knowledge): 10% x 1pp x 65% loss = 6.5bp of loans = ~Rs900cr = 1.2% of PBT x persistence 0.5 => ~-0.6; rounded -0.8 to include fee/volume cutback. ICICI is less exposed than IDFC First or IndusInd.

One tightening step (higher risk weights on unsecured/NBFC, LCR/ project-finance provisioning, deposit run-off factors): capital-light bank with CET1 well above minimum so impact on growth is modest; +1 step -> ROE -20bp -> ~-1.5% value. Counterweight: RBI eased several rules in 2025 so direction of travel is uncertain.

evidence.note: RBI 2025-26 regulatory easing vs tightening cycle; not re-verified for Aug-Nov 2026

exposures.mechanism: +US$5bn/qtr FPI inflow: ICICI is among the most owned FII stocks (FII ~45% of float, model knowledge) with beta ~0.9 to Nifty; +US$5bn ~ Nifty +2% => ICICI +2% in a flow-driven rerating. Market-wide component is demeaned by the Director; relative impact is higher than average because of FII weight.

+3% USD/INR (weaker rupee): small direct P&L effect (foreign-currency book ~5% of loans, hedged); FCNR(B) swap cost and FPI-outflow risk dominate. Pack's empirical -1.35 per SSU (t=-1.7, weak) agrees in sign and size; INR is 94.49, +6.5% in 12m.

evidence.note: FCNR(B) inflows pressed NIM 7-8bp at peers; ICICI 'FCNR(B) deposits press NIM' (TradingView 2026-10-26)

exposures.mechanism: +Rs1 lakh cr surplus liquidity lowers CD/bulk funding rates and lifts treasury yields; ~5bp NIM on the marginal 15% of funding => +0.6. RBI hiked while system liquidity is tighter than 2025, so absence of surplus is a mild headwind.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo to 5.50%, stance calibrated tightening (Hindu/Reuters/Moneycontrol headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Govt introduced 0.4% MDR on merchant UPI payments above Rs2,000 (capped Rs300/txn) on 2026-09-15: ICICI is a top merchant acquirer/sponsor bank so acquiring fee pool opens up; stock rallied that day. Merchant-payments fees ~Rs1-2k cr industry-wide for ICICI => <1% of PAT x persistence 1.0 => +0.5.

evidence.note: Paytm, SBI, YES, ICICI shares rally after 0.4% MDR on merchant UPI (Upstox); MDR fixed 0.4% for txns >Rs2,000, cap Rs300 (Moneycontrol)

exposures.mechanism: +10% Brent: INR/CPI/RBI-hike channel (macro_transmission through USDINR and repo already counted) leaves only a residual sentiment effect; pack empirical -0.30 (t=-1.0) agrees. Brent at ~$95 (+15% in 3m).
+5 VIX points ~ Nifty -3%; ICICI beta 0.9 => -2.7 absolute, partly defensive quality premium => -2.0. Largely market-wide; Director demeans cross-section.
+1pp GDP growth -> loan growth +1.5pp, lower credit cost -5bp -> PAT +3.5%; persistence 0.7 => +2.5. RBI raised FY27 GDP forecast to 7.1% on 2026-10-07 (Moneycontrol).

company_links.mechanism: ICICI Bank owns ~51.3% of ICICI Lombard (pack promoter holding 51.28%); stake ~Rs41k cr (51.3% x ~Rs80k cr mcap) = ~4% of ICICI Bank mcap (~Rs10.6 lakh cr) => 1% move in ICICIGI = ~0.04% ICICI Bank.
ICICI Bank holds ~51% of ICICI Prudential AMC (model knowledge; promoter group 85.60% incl. Prudential plc); stake ~Rs75k cr = ~7% of ICICI Bank mcap => 1% move in ICICIAMC = ~0.07% ICICI Bank.
